ammo.desc: returns amount of ammo held for currently selected weapon

bestammo.desc: returns ammo held for the 'best' weapon

bestweapon.desc: returns name of best weapon in inventory

cam_angles.desc: returns current camera angles, in format that can be passed to /cam_angles command.

cam_pos.desc: returns current camera position, in format that can be passed to /cam_pos command.

cam_pos_x.desc: returns one component of current camera position.

cam_pos_y.desc: returns one component of current camera position.

cam_pos_z.desc: returns one component of current camera position.

cells.desc: returns number of cells held, regardless of weapon selected

colored_armor.desc: returns $armor, surrounded by color codes so it is displayed in &c0b0red&r, &cff0yellow&r, &e00green&r or &cfffwhite&r

colored_powerups.desc: current powerups held as color-coded full names (quad, pent, ring), concatenated without separator.

colored_short_powerups.desc: current powerups held as compact color-coded initials (q=quad blue, r=ring yellow, p=pent red); output order is q-r-p. Returns empty string when no powerups held.

connectiontype.desc: returns the current type of the connection

date.desc: returns the current date in the format <day>.<month>.<year>

dateiso.desc: current local date and time in ISO-adjacent format YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM.

deathloc.desc: map location name where the player last died, or tp_name_someplace if no death has been recorded this session.

demolength.desc: returns the expected length of the current demo, in seconds

demoname.desc: returns the name of the current demo, minus extension

demoplayback.desc: returns whether or not the client is current watching a demo

demotime.desc: current demo playback time in seconds (float). Intended for scripted and timed camera movement.

droploc.desc: returns the name of the location where the last backpack was dropped by the current player.

droptime.desc: returns the number of seconds since the last backpack was dropped by the current player.

gamedir.desc:
returns the current gamedir, which is often set when a server is running a mod.
e.g: 'fortress' for Team Fortress mods

lastip.desc: IP address or hostname:port of the last server seen in console output, captured by an internal trigger pattern.

lastloc.desc: location name at time of last death if death occurred within the past 5 seconds; otherwise current location name.

lastpowerup.desc: powerups last seen on the enemy within the past 5 seconds (e.g. "quad pent"); falls back to the value of tp_name_quad when no recent sighting.

latency.desc: current network latency in milliseconds, rounded to nearest integer.

ledpoint.desc: LED color code indicating the type of entity pointed at: red for enemy, green for teammate, yellow for powerup, blue for item.

ledstatus.desc: LED color code reflecting how many items the player currently needs: green for none, yellow for one, red for two or more.

location.desc: name of the player's current map location, as defined by the active .loc file.

matchname.desc: current match name, derived from the active match-format template (e.g. "duel/playerA_vs_playerB - [dm6]"). Returns "No match in progress" when not connected.

matchstatus.desc: current match state: one of "disconnected", "standby", or "normal".

matchtype.desc: current match type keyword: one of duel, ffa, 2on2, 3on3, 4on4, tdm, arena, tfduel, tfclanwar, solo, coop, race, empty, unknown. Returns "No match in progress" when not connected.

nails.desc: returns number of nails held, regardless of weapon selected

need.desc: separator-delimited list of items the player currently needs based on tp_need_* thresholds (e.g. "armor health rl").

ping.desc: current network latency in milliseconds, rounded to nearest integer. Alias for $latency.

point.desc: name of the nearest item or entity the player is pointing at, as used in location-pointing messages; returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed.

pointatloc.desc: pointed-at item name combined with its location, in "name at location" format; bounded by the tp_pointtimeout cvar and returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed or the timeout expires.

pointloc.desc: map location of the entity pointed at, or current location if no specific point location is available; returns tp_name_nothing when the player is flashed.

powerups.desc: separator-delimited list of powerups currently held (quad, pent, ring, flag for CTF/TF); returns tp_name_none when none held.

qt.desc: returns " - useful to clear cvars in scripts

rockets.desc: returns number of rockets held, regardless of weapon selected

serverip.desc: current server IP address and port, in ip:port form.

shells.desc: returns number of shells held, regardless of weapon selected

team1.desc: name of the Nth team currently playing, alphabetically sorted; $team1 returns the first team, $team2 the second. In FFA (no teamplay), returns player names instead. Falls back to literal "team1"/"team2" when fewer teams exist.

team2.desc: name of the Nth team currently playing, alphabetically sorted; $team1 returns the first team, $team2 the second. In FFA (no teamplay), returns player names instead. Falls back to literal "team1"/"team2" when fewer teams exist.

tf_skin.desc: current player's skin name, with TeamFortress skin prefixes expanded to full class names (e.g. tf_demo -> demoman, tf_eng -> engineer).

time.desc: returns the local time in the format <hours>:<minutes>

timestamp.desc: current local date and time as a compact filesystem-safe string: YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

took.desc: name of the last item picked up; returns tp_name_nothing if nothing has been picked up yet.

tookatloc.desc: last item picked up with its pickup location, in "name at location" format; returns tp_name_nothing when no item has been picked up.

tookloc.desc: map location name where the last item was picked up; returns tp_name_someplace when no item has been picked up.

tp_powerups.desc: $colored_powerups or $colored_short_powerups, depending on value of tp_poweruptextstyle

triggermatch.desc: full text of the console message that last fired a regexp trigger.

weapon.desc: name of the currently active weapon, using tp_name_* cvar values (e.g. "rl", "lg").

weaponnum.desc: currently active weapon as a slot number (1-8), or pre-selected best weapon number when cl_weaponpreselect is enabled.

weapons.desc: separator-delimited list of all weapons currently held, ordered from strongest to weakest (lg, rl, gl, sng, ng, ssg, sg, axe).
